criteria.text: The settlement contract is deployed to Stellar testnet and its contract id is public
criteria.rationale: The contract id resolves on the testnet explorer and matches the id recorded in the repository's deployment file.

criteria.text: Unauthorized callers cannot approve a milestone or release funds
criteria.rationale: Seven tests in negative_auth.rs present a valid signature from the wrong role and each is refused.

criteria.text: A milestone cannot be released twice
criteria.rationale: test_double_release_rejected asserts both the error and that the balance did not move a second time.

criteria.text: A sponsor can reclaim an undelivered milestone after its deadline, but not before
criteria.rationale: Refunds are covered before, at, and after the deadline, including the exact-deadline boundary.

criteria.text: An automated test shows that an advisory score of 100 cannot release funds
criteria.rationale: test_ai_score_100_cannot_release constructs a 100/100 report and shows approve and release both refused without the reviewer's signature.
